menuCards.name: Rara Paneer
menuCards.description: Succulent cubes of fresh cottage cheese are simmered in a thick, robust gravy that features a base of finely grated paneer and minced seasonal vegetables. This creates a rich, "keema-style" texture that clings beautifully to the soft paneer chunks. Slow-cooked with a pungent blend of garlic, ginger, and hand-pounded whole spices, the gravy is deep, savory, and intensely flavorful.

menuCards.name: Rara Chaap
menuCards.description: Our Rara Chaap is a bold, hearty Punjabi specialty that offers a "double dose" of satisfaction. Succulent, juicy soya chunks are simmered in a thick, robust gravy featuring a base of finely minced soya (keema) and slow-cooked aromatics. This unique combination creates a rich, "meaty" texture that ensures the savory masala clings to every bite of the tender chaap

menuCards.name: Paneer Tikka Butter Masala
menuCards.description: This dish brings together the best of the tandoor and the tandoori gravy. We start with succulent cubes of Paneer that have been marinated in a spicy hung-curd "tikka" masala and charred to perfection in our clay tandoor. These smoky, golden-edged tikka chunks are then folded into our signature buttery tomato-cream sauce.

menuCards.name: Chaap Lababdar
menuCards.description: Our Chaap Lababdar features tender, succulent soya chunks simmered in a rich, luscious gravy made from sun-ripened tomatoes, cashews, and slow-cooked onions.

menuCards.name: Shahi Paneer
menuCards.description: A royal feast fit for the Nawabs! Our Shahi Paneer is the epitome of elegance, featuring succulent cubes of fresh, melt-in-your-mouth cottage cheese (Paneer) simmered in a majestic, golden-hued gravy. The sauce is a silky-smooth masterpiece crafted from ground cashews, premium cream, and a delicate blend of aromatic spices like cardamom and saffron. Unlike other spicy dishes, this Shahi classic offers a subtle sweetness and a rich, nutty depth that feels truly celebratory.

menuCards.name: Tawa Paneer Masala
menuCards.description: The ultimate street-style sensation! Our Tawa Paneer Masala is a vibrant, "chatpata" dish that captures the smoky, rustic essence of a roadside Punjabi eatery. Succulent cubes of fresh paneer are tossed on a searing iron griddle (Tawa) with a colorful medley of crunchy bell peppers, diced onions, and juicy tomatoes.

menuCards.name: Jeera Aloo
menuCards.description: Our Jeera Aloo is a simple yet stunning celebration of rustic flavors, featuring tender, golden-brown potato chunks saut?d to perfection. The star of the dish is the "Jeera" (cumin)?empered in hot oil until it crackles and releases its earthy, nutty aroma, coating every potato slice. Tossed with a piquant blend of turmeric, toasted coriander powder, and a hint of tangy amchur (dry mango powder), this dry dish is finished with a generous garnish of fresh, hand-torn coriander and piquant green chilies

menuCards.name: Palak Paneer
menuCards.description: The ultimate green soul food! Our Palak Paneer is a vibrant and nutritious masterpiece made from fresh, farm-picked spinach that is blanched and pur?d to a silky smooth texture. This emerald-green gravy is tempered with aromatic cumin, finely minced garlic, and a hint of ginger, then slow-cooked with succulent cubes of soft cottage cheese (Paneer). The mild, earthy flavor of the spinach is elevated by a touch of fresh cream and a dash of Garam Masala, creating a dish that is light on the stomach but rich in flavor.

menuCards.name: Malai Kofta
menuCards.description: The crown jewel of vegetarian luxury! Our Malai Kofta features velvety, melt-in-your-mouth dumplings crafted from a delicate blend of mashed potatoes, crumbled paneer, and a secret mix of nuts and raisins.

menuCards.name: Chaap Dhaniya Adraki
menuCards.description: Tempered with whole spices and finished with a squeeze of lime, it? a fragrant, "chatpata" masterpiece that offers a sophisticated alternative to the usual rich curries. Sophisticated, aromatic, and deeply soul-satisfying!

menuCards.name: Dhaba Dal Fry
menuCards.description: Unlike the lighter home-style versions, this dal features a bold and spicy "bhuna" masala of caramelized onions, juicy tomatoes, and piquant green chilies. The secret lies in the double tempering?izzling in pure desi ghee with a heavy hand of minced garlic, smoky cumin, and a dash of fiery red chili powder.

menuCards.name: Kadhai Chaap
menuCards.description: Cooked in a traditional iron wok on a high flame to lock in a distinct smoky aroma, every bite is a perfect harmony of chewy texture and fiery, peppery spice. Finished with fresh ginger juliennes and aromatic coriander, it? the ultimate choice for those who love their chaap with a spicy, authentic kick!

menuCards.name: Kadhai Mushroom
menuCards.description: A bold and rustic celebration of earthy flavors! Our Kadhai Mushroom features plump, juicy button mushrooms stir-fried with crunchy bell peppers, diced onions, and succulent tomatoes in a thick, semi-dry gravy

menuCards.name: Kadhai Paneer
menuCards.description: A bold and fiery celebration of North Indian flavors! Our Kadhai Paneer features succulent cubes of fresh cottage cheese stir-fried with crunchy bell peppers, juicy tomatoes, and piquant red onions in a thick, semi-dry gravy. The heart of this dish lies in our signature "Kadhai Masala"? hand-pounded blend of toasted coriander seeds, spicy dried red chilies, and black peppercorns. Cooked in a traditional iron wok (Kadhai) to lock in a distinct smoky aroma, every bite is a perfect balance of rustic texture and vibrant, peppery spice

menuCards.name: Keema Chaap Masala
menuCards.description: A robust, "meaty" vegetarian masterpiece! Our Keema Chaap Masala is a unique and hearty Punjabi specialty that offers a dual-layered indulgence. We take tender, succulent soya chunks and simmer them in a thick, flavor-packed gravy made from finely minced (keema-style) soya and seasonal aromatics

menuCards.name: Khum Palak
menuCards.description: An earthy, iron-rich delight for the gourmet diner! Our Khum Palak features plump, juicy mushrooms (Khum) simmered in a vibrant, silky-smooth pur? of farm-fresh spinach. This emerald-green gravy is slow-cooked with a light tempering of golden-fried garlic, aromatic cumin, and a hint of warming ginger.

menuCards.name: Matar Mushroom
menuCards.description: The mushrooms are saut?d to a perfect "meaty" texture, while the peas add a burst of garden-fresh sweetness in every bite. Infused with a fragrant blend of ginger, garlic, and toasted kitchen-king spices, the dish is finished with a touch of fresh cream and aromatic kasuri methi for a silky, "dhaba-style" finish.

menuCards.name: Matar Paneer
menuCards.description: A timeless North Indian classic that tastes like home! Our Matar Paneer is a soulful combination of succulent cottage cheese cubes and plump, tender green peas simmered in a luscious, onion-tomato based gravy. Infused with a fragrant tempering of cumin, ginger, and garlic, the sauce is cooked until it reaches a perfect velvety consistency, balancing a mild tang with a hint of natural sweetness from the peas.

menuCards.name: Mixed Vegetables
menuCards.description: A vibrant harvest of farm-fresh flavors! Our Mixed Vegetables is a wholesome and colorful celebration of seasonal produce, featuring a crunch-perfect medley of cauliflower florets, tender green peas, piquant carrots, French beans, and soft potato chunks. Each vegetable is carefully saut?d to retain its natural sweetness and texture, then tossed in a rustic, semi-dry onion-tomato gravy.

menuCards.name: Mushroom Dhaniya Adraki
menuCards.description: Plump, earthy button mushrooms are saut?d to perfection and tossed in a luscious semi-dry gravy featuring a unique paste of garden-fresh coriander and hand-pounded ginger juliennes.

menuCards.name: Paneer Bhurji
menuCards.description: Our Paneer Bhurji is a rustic, high-energy dish featuring fresh, hand-crumbled cottage cheese saut?d to perfection. We toss it on a high flame with a vibrant "tadka" of finely chopped red onions, juicy tomatoes, and piquant green chilies.

menuCards.name: Paneer Butter Masala
menuCards.description: The undisputed king of North Indian comfort food! Our Paneer Butter Masala is a rich, velvety masterpiece that strikes the perfect balance between indulgence and flavor. Succulent, melt-in-your-mouth cubes of fresh cottage cheese are bathed in a luscious, bright orange gravy made from sun-ripened tomatoes, slow-cooked onions, and a buttery cashew paste.

menuCards.name: Paneer Dhaniya Adraki
menuCards.description: A refreshing and aromatic standout from the heart of Punjab! Our Paneer Dhaniya Adraki is a vibrant celebration of two essential Indian flavors?resh, fragrant green coriander (Dhaniya) and zingy, warming ginger (Adrak). Soft, succulent cubes of paneer are tossed in a luscious, semi-dry gravy that features a unique paste of garden-fresh coriander leaves and hand-pounded ginger juliennes.

menuCards.name: Paneer Do Pyaza
menuCards.description: The ultimate celebration of onions and spice! "Do Pyaza" literally means "onions twice," and this dish lives up to its name by using onions in two distinct ways. First, we slow-cook a rich, velvety onion-tomato base, and then we toss in large, succulent cubes of paneer along with crunchy, saut?d onion petals.

menuCards.name: Paneer Lababdar
menuCards.description: An irresistible, "mouth-watering" masterpiece that defines Punjabi luxury! Our Paneer Lababdar features succulent cubes of fresh cottage cheese and grated paneer simmered in a rich, luscious gravy of tomatoes, cashews, and onions. What makes it truly "Lababdar" is its unique texture? velvety, cream-based sauce that is perfectly balanced between tangy and sweet, enhanced with a generous tempering of butter and aromatic kasuri methi.

menuCards.name: Paneer Rogan Josh
menuCards.description: A vegetarian tribute to a royal Kashmiri classic! Our Paneer Rogan Josh is a fragrant and deeply flavorful dish that replaces the traditional meat with succulent, golden-fried cubes of fresh cottage cheese. The soul of this dish lies in its vibrant, thin, and aromatic red gravy, naturally colored with the essence of Ratan Jot (Alkanet root) and Kashmiri red chilies

menuCards.name: Soya Tawa Chaap
menuCards.description: Tossed with a vibrant medley of crunchy bell peppers, sliced onions, and tangy tomatoes, it is coated in a thick, semi-dry masala that is bold, smoky, and intensely flavorful. Infused with a dash of piquant Pav Bhaji masala and finished with fresh coriander and a squeeze of lime, it? a "chatpata" masterpiece that delivers an authentic Punjabi street-food kick in every bite!

menuCards.name: Spl. Dal Makhani
menuCards.description: Tempered with a rich blend of vine-ripened tomatoes, ginger, and garlic, the dal is finished with a lavish amount of white butter and fresh dairy cream. Infused with a delicate hint of smoky charcoal (Dhungar), every spoonful is velvety, rich, and soul-satisfying. It? not just a dish; it? an emotion. Best paired with a Butter Naan or Garlic Naan for the ultimate royal experience!

menuCards.name: Spl. Dal Tadka (yellow)
menuCards.description: The ultimate comfort in a bowl! Our Special Dal Tadka is a soul-warming blend of premium yellow lentils (Arhar and Moong), pressure-cooked to a perfect, velvety consistency.

menuCards.name: Spl. Rogan Josh
menuCards.description: Our Special Veg Rogan Josh is an aromatic masterpiece that replaces meat with a hearty medley of succulent soya chunks and golden-fried cottage cheese. The soul of this dish lies in its signature "Josh"? vibrant, thin, and deeply flavorful red gravy naturally infused with the essence of Alkanet root (Ratan Jot) and premium Kashmiri chilies.

menuCards.name: Tawa Mix Masala
menuCards.description: Tossed succulent cubes of fresh paneer, tender soya chunks, and a colorful harvest of seasonal vegetables on a searing hot iron griddle (Tawa)

menuCards.name: Tawa Mushroom
menuCards.description: Mushroom chunks are tossed with a vibrant "bhuna" masala of caramelized onions, tangy tomatoes, and crunchy bell peppers. The high-heat cooking on the tawa infuses the dish with a distinct smoky aroma and a thick, flavor-packed glaze that clings to every bite

menuCards.name: Onion Roti
menuCards.description: A flavorful, rustic treat with a zesty crunch! Our Onion Roti is made from wholesome whole-wheat dough, infused with a generous amount of finely hand-chopped red onions, spicy green chilies, and fresh coriander. As it bakes in the high heat of the traditional clay tandoor, the onions soften and caramelize slightly, releasing their natural sweetness into the smoky, charred bread.

menuCards.name: Onion Paratha
menuCards.description: The rustic, flavor-packed favorite for a true North Indian soul! Our Onion Paratha is a hearty and wholesome whole-wheat flatbread that is stuffed to the edges with a savory filling of finely hand-chopped red onions, piquant green chilies, and fresh garden coriander. Seasoned with a "chatpata" blend of tangy amchur (dry mango powder) and roasted cumin, it is expertly rolled and baked in the intense heat of a traditional clay tandoor.

menuCards.name: Green Chilli Paratha
menuCards.description: For those who love an extra kick of heat! Our Green Chilli Paratha is a fiery, multi-layered masterpiece made from wholesome whole-wheat dough. Each layer is skillfully pleated and generously loaded with a "thecha" of finely hand-chopped, piquant green chilies and fresh coriander.

menuCards.name: Paneer Paratha
menuCards.description: The ultimate protein-packed comfort feast! Our Paneer Paratha is a hearty whole-wheat flatbread stuffed to the edges with a rich and savory filling of fresh, hand-crumbled cottage cheese (Paneer). Seasoned with a "chatpata" blend of tangy amchur, roasted cumin, and a hint of fiery green chilies, the filling is both creamy and flavorful. Expertly rolled and baked in the intense heat of our traditional clay tandoor, it develops a beautiful golden-brown char and a distinct smoky aroma.

menuCards.name: Missi Roti
menuCards.description: The rustic, high-protein soul of North Indian dining! Our Missi Roti is a savory masterpiece crafted from a traditional blend of wholesome whole wheat flour and protein-rich gram flour (Besan). The dough is seasoned with a fragrant "masala" of hand-crushed coriander seeds, earthy turmeric, a pinch of carom seeds (Ajwain) for digestion, and a handful of fresh green coriander.

menuCards.name: Aloo Naan
menuCards.description: The ultimate comfort bread for a hearty Punjabi feast! Our Aloo Naan is hand-crafted from premium, leavened dough and stuffed with a generous, savory filling of boiled mashed potatoes seasoned with a "chatpata" blend of roasted cumin, dry mango powder (amchur), and a hint of fresh green chilies.

menuCards.name: Aloo Paratha
menuCards.description: The quintessential taste of a Punjabi home! Our Aloo Paratha is a hearty, wholesome classic made from premium whole-wheat dough. It is stuffed to the brim with a soul-satisfying filling of boiled, mashed potatoes blended with a "chatpata" mix of hand-pounded spices

menuCards.name: Aloo Pyaz Naan
menuCards.description: The ultimate "best of both worlds" comfort bread! Our Aloo Pyaz Naan is a thick, pillowy masterpiece made from premium leavened dough, stuffed with a hearty and flavorful blend of seasoned mashed potatoes and zesty, finely chopped red onions. Infused with a "chatpata" mix of roasted cumin, fresh coriander, and a hint of green chili, it is hand-stretched and baked in the searing heat of a traditional clay tandoor.

menuCards.name: Aloo Pyaz Paratha
menuCards.description: The ultimate "Dhaba-style" comfort classic! This hearty whole-wheat flatbread is a crowd favorite, stuffed with a soul-satisfying blend of spiced mashed potatoes and finely hand-chopped red onions. The creamy texture of the potatoes perfectly complements the zesty crunch of the onions, all seasoned with a signature mix of tangy amchur, roasted cumin, and fresh green coriander. Expertly baked in our traditional clay tandoor, it carries a beautiful smoky aroma and a perfectly charred, golden-brown crust

menuCards.name: Butter Naan
menuCards.description: The ultimate indulgence and the king of Indian breads! Our Butter Naan is crafted from premium, leavened dough that is hand-stretched and slapped onto the roaring clay walls of a traditional tandoor. The intense heat causes the bread to bubble and rise, creating a signature pillowy-soft texture with a delicate, smoky char. As soon as it

menuCards.name: Butter Roti
menuCards.description: A rustic classic made indulgent! Our Butter Tandoori Roti is crafted from premium whole wheat flour, hand-stretched and traditionaly baked against the searing clay walls of a roaring tandoor. The intense charcoal heat creates those iconic charred "spots" and a deep, smoky aroma that defines authentic North Indian dining

menuCards.name: Garlic Butter Roti
menuCards.description: The aromatic upgrade to your favorite staple! Our Garlic Butter Roti is hand-crafted from wholesome whole wheat flour and baked to perfection in the high heat of a traditional clay tandoor. What makes it special is the generous topping of finely minced, golden-roasted garlic that is pressed into the dough, releasing its pungent and savory aroma as it bakes. Fresh out of the oven, it is brushed with a luscious layer of melting golden butter that mingles with the charred garlic bits for an explosion of flavor in every bite

menuCards.name: Garlic Naan
menuCards.description: The aromatic superstar of the Tandoor! Our Garlic Naan is a flavor-packed experience, made from premium leavened dough that is hand-stretched and topped with a generous layer of finely minced, pungent garlic and fresh coriander. As it bakes against the searing clay walls of the tandoor, the garlic bits become beautifully roasted and golden, infusing the soft, pillowy bread with an irresistible savory aroma.

menuCards.name: Lachha Paratha
menuCards.description: The masterpiece of Indian flatbreads! Our Lachha Paratha is a visual and textural delight, crafted by skillfully folding and pleating wholesome whole-wheat dough to create dozens of delicate, concentric rings. Expertly baked in the high heat of a traditional clay tandoor, it emerges with a beautiful golden-brown hue and a distinct smoky aroma. The result is a multi-layered marvel that is spectacularly crispy on the outside while remaining soft and flaky on the inside.

menuCards.name: Mix Paratha
menuCards.description: The ultimate garden-fresh feast in a fold! Our Mix Veg Paratha is a wholesome whole-wheat flatbread that brings together a vibrant medley of seasonal vegetables

menuCards.name: Onion Kulcha
menuCards.description: A soft, airy, and zesty treat for the senses! Our Onion Kulcha is a premium leavened flatbread, hand-stretched and generously stuffed with a savory filling of finely hand-chopped red onions, piquant green chilies, and fresh garden coriander. Seasoned with a "chatpata" blend of tangy amchur (dry mango powder) and roasted cumin, it is baked against the glowing clay walls of a traditional tandoor.

menuCards.name: Onion Missi Roti
menuCards.description: A "chatpata" twist on a nutritious classic! Our Onion Missi Roti is a flavor-packed upgrade to the traditional recipe. We blend protein-rich gram flour (Besan) with whole wheat flour and load it with a generous amount of finely hand-chopped red onions, spicy green chilies, and fresh coriander. As it bakes against the hot clay walls of the tandoor, the onions caramelize slightly, giving the nutty, golden-brown bread a sweet and savory crunch in every bite.

menuCards.name: Onion Naan
menuCards.description: A zesty, flavor-packed twist on our classic pillowy naan! This premium bread is hand-stretched from leavened dough and generously topped with a savory "masala" of finely hand-chopped red onions, spicy green chilies, and fresh coriander. As it bakes against the glowing clay walls of the traditional tandoor, the onions soften and caramelize, infusing the soft, airy bread with a delightful sweetness and a sharp, aromatic crunch. Finished with a luscious brush of melting golden butter, every bite offers a perfect balance of smoky char, buttery richness, and zesty onion flavor.

menuCards.name: Paneer Kulcha
menuCards.description: The crown jewel of stuffed breads! Our Paneer Kulcha is a soft, fluffy masterpiece made from premium leavened dough, generously stuffed with a rich filling of fresh, crumbled cottage cheese (paneer). The filling is delicately seasoned with a fragrant blend of roasted cumin, finely chopped green chilies, and a handful of fresh garden coriander. Hand-stretched and baked to perfection in the intense heat of a traditional clay tandoor, it emerges with a beautiful golden char and a soft, airy texture.

menuCards.name: Plain Naan
menuCards.description: The soft, pillowy classic of the Indian tandoor! Our Plain Naan is made from premium refined flour, leavened to perfection and hand-stretched into its iconic teardrop shape. Baked in the searing heat of a traditional clay tandoor, it bubbles up to create a beautiful contrast of airy, cloud-like softness and delicate, charred crispness. With its subtle smoky aroma and neutral flavor, it is the sophisticated choice for those who want their bread to be a gentle companion to rich, aromatic gravies and creamy dals. Light, elegant, and melt-in-your-mouth delicious.

menuCards.name: Punjabi Keema Kulcha
menuCards.description: A royal, protein-packed treat for our vegetarian foodies! This "Keema" Kulcha is a clever and delicious twist on the classic, featuring a rich filling of finely minced soya and garden-fresh vegetables, slow-cooked in a robust "bhuna" masala. Seasoned with ginger, garlic, and a secret blend of hand-pounded Punjabi spices, the texture perfectly mimics the traditional version. Hand-stretched and baked in the searing heat of our clay tandoor, it develops a beautiful smoky char while the savory juices soak into the soft, pillowy dough.

menuCards.name: Rumali Roti
menuCards.description: The "Handkerchief Bread" of the Nawabs! True to its name, our Rumali Roti is a marvel of culinary skill

menuCards.name: Tandoori Roti
menuCards.description: Our Tandoori Roti is made from fine whole wheat flour, hand-stretched and slapped onto the roaring clay walls of a traditional tandoor. The intense, dry heat of the charcoal fire gives it a beautiful char, a distinct smoky aroma, and a satisfyingly chewy-crisp texture.

menuCards.name: Plain Rice
menuCards.description: The ultimate canvas for your favorite flavors! Our Plain Rice features premium, long-grain Basmati, carefully aged and steamed to perfection so that every grain is distinct, fluffy, and aromatic.

menuCards.name: Jeera Rice
menuCards.description: An aromatic Indian classic that elevates every meal! We use premium, long-grain Basmati rice, aged to perfection and steamed so that every grain stays fluffy and distinct. The magic happens when the rice is tempered in pure cow ghee with a generous crackle of hand-picked cumin seeds (Jeera) and whole aromatic spices like cloves and green cardamom. The result is a fragrant, buttery delight with an earthy, toasted flavor profile that perfectly complements everything from a simple Dal Tadka to a rich, spicy Gravy.

menuCards.name: Fried Rice
menuCards.description: The crown jewel of Indo-Chinese comfort food! Our Fried Rice features premium, long-grain Basmati rice, cooled and then wok-tossed on a roaring flame to achieve a delicate smoky "wok-hei" soul. It is stir-fried with a vibrant, finely diced medley of crunchy carrots, snap-crisp beans, sweet bell peppers, and golden-brown garlic. Seasoned with a precise balance of light soy sauce, a hint of white pepper, and aromatic sesame oil, every grain is perfectly coated and distinct

menuCards.name: Paneer Fried Rice
menuCards.description: The ultimate vegetarian upgrade to an Indo-Chinese classic! We take premium, long-grain Basmati rice and wok-toss it on a roaring flame with a vibrant medley of finely diced carrots, beans, and crunchy bell peppers to capture that authentic smoky "wok-hei" soul. menuCards.name: Spl. Veg Biryani

menuCards.name: Paneer Tikka
menuCards.description: The quintessential tandoori classic! Generous cubes of fresh, premium paneer are marinated in a bold and aromatic "Tandoori" blend of thick hung curd, pungent ginger-garlic paste, and a signature mix of hand-ground spices including Kashmiri red chili and roasted garam masala. Skewered with crunchy petals of onions and vibrant capsicum, the paneer is grilled to perfection in a traditional clay oven.

menuCards.name: Dahi Ke Sholey

menuCards.name: Haryali Chaap
menuCards.description: A refreshing, aromatic burst of garden-fresh flavors! Succulent ribbons of soya chaap are steeped in a vibrant "Green" marinade

To give it that iconic "KFC-style" twist, each piece is double-coated in a secret seasoned batter and flash-fried to create a dramatic, ultra-crispy golden crust.

menuCards.name: Kfc Masala Chaap
menuCards.description: The ultimate spicy crunch! We take succulent soya chaap and marinate it in a bold, "Desi-style" tandoori masala blend of fiery red chilies, pungent ginger-garlic, and aromatic roasted spices. For that signature "KFC-style" finish, each piece is double-dredged in a seasoned, high-texture batter and flash-fried to create a massive, golden-brown crunch.

These charred, golden-brown chunks are tucked inside a soft, paper-thin Rumali Roti, creating a perfect harmony of textures.

These tender pieces are skewered and charred to a delicate golden-brown in our traditional clay tandoor, infusing them with a subtle smoky aroma while keeping the inside incredibly juicy.

menuCards.name: Boti Kabab Roll
menuCards.description: Wrapped in a paper-thin, hand-tossed Rumali Roti, we layer it with tangy vinegar onions and a generous swirl of our signature spicy mint chutney. Every bite offers a deep, savory, and smoky flavor that perfectly mimics the texture of a traditional boti kabab. Bold, rustic, and incredibly satisfying!

menuCards.name: Haryali Tikka Roll
menuCards.description: Wrapped in a soft, paper-thin Rumali Roti and layered with crunchy laccha onions and a dash of tangy lemon, every bite offers a refreshing, zesty, and earthy kick. It

menuCards.name: Paneer Tikka Roll
menuCards.description: Our Paneer Tikka Roll features large, succulent cubes of fresh cottage cheese that have been marinated overnight in a "chatpata" blend of hung curd, Kashmiri red chilies, and hand-pounded spices. After being skewered and charred to a golden perfection in our clay tandoor, these smoky tikka chunks are wrapped inside a soft, hand-tossed Rumali Roti.

These crunchy bites are glazed in a bold, savory-sweet fusion of fiery red chili paste, dark soy sauce, and a generous infusion of pungent garlic. Stir-fried with crisp bell peppers and aromatic spring onions, every potato wedge is perfectly coated in a glossy, spicy sauce that packs a punch.

Stir-fried with crunchy capsicum, bulbous onions, and a heavy infusion of pungent garlic and fiery green chilies, these bites soak up all the savory goodness.

These crunchy bites are glazed in a luscious, glossy sauce that perfectly balances the fiery heat of red chilies and pungent garlic with the smooth, amber sweetness of pure honey. menuCards.name: Chilli Garlic Noodles
menuCards.description: For those who love their meal with a bold, aromatic punch! This dish features silky, al dente noodles wok-tossed on a high flame to capture a deep, smoky "wok-hei" soul. The star of the show is the intense infusion of golden-brown roasted garlic and fiery dried red chilies, creating a pungent and spicy flavor profile that lingers on the palate.

menuCards.name: Hakka Noodles
menuCards.description: The sophisticated, subtle side of Indo-Chinese cuisine! This dish features long, silky strands of al dente noodles, wok-tossed on a high flame with a vibrant, garden-fresh medley of crunchy cabbage, julienned carrots, snap-crisp beans, and colorful bell peppers. Unlike its spicy cousins, Hakka Noodles are seasoned delicately with light soy sauce, a hint of white pepper, and aromatic ginger-garlic to allow the natural flavors of the fresh vegetables to shine through.

menuCards.name: Soya Noodles

We take silky, wok-tossed al dente noodles and load them with succulent, protein-rich soya granules or thinly sliced soya chunks that have been seasoned to perfection. Wok-fried on a roaring flame with a crunchy medley of garden-fresh cabbage, carrots, and bell peppers, the soya soaks up the bold flavors of dark soy sauce and aromatic spices

menuCards.name: Veg. Kurkure Momos

This cooling classic is made with thick, velvety yogurt whisked to a silky-smooth finish and loaded with freshly grated, juice-heavy cucumbers.
